project_name: Conteo de Visitas - Domingo Alonso Group

design_philosophy.description: A fusion of German automotive engineering precision with the sustainable, organic ethos of the Canary Islands headquarters. Clean lines, high contrast, and data density without clutter.
core_principles: Data as Art: Every number must be legible from 5 meters away.
Brand Integrity: Brand colors must be exact.
Motion with Meaning: Animations signal real-time data updates.

headings.usage: Page titles, KPI numbers, Brand names

Login.style: Glassmorphism Card centered on animated gradient background

KPICard.style: Border-l-4 border-primary bg-surface shadow-sm rounded-lg p-6

BrandRanking.style: Horizontal Bar Chart with Brand Logos as labels
BrandRanking.interaction: Hover scales bar and shows precise count

NOCMap.style: Dark map background with Island Silhouettes placed geographically

instructions_to_main_agent: Create or update '/app/frontend/src/ConteoApp.jsx' as the main entry point.
Create or update '/app/frontend/src/Conteo.css' for custom styles not covered by Tailwind.
Ensure 'dag-logo.png' is visible on the Login screen and Header.
Implement a 'NOC Mode' toggle that switches the entire UI to the Dark Theme defined above.
Use 'lucide-react' for all icons (User, Camera, LogOut, BarChart, Map, etc.).
Mock data for now, but structure it to be easily replaced with API calls.
For the NOC Competitive view, make it FULLSCREEN by default or have a button to toggle fullscreen.
Footer text: Left: 'Domingo Alonso Group', Right: 'Desarrollado por Siempria | Tecnología Mobotix'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for dark backgrounds, use solid dark colors.
Avoid centering text in main content areas unless it's a specific card design.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
